compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of an educational app focused on teaching Java. The screen is titled "Introduction to Java" and presents a multiple-choice question related to Java development. The question asks, "To distribute your application to different platforms, how many Java versions do you need to create?" 

Below the question, there are three answer options:
1. Just one version
2. Two versions
3. One for each platform

At the bottom right, there is a green button labeled "CHECK" for submitting the selected answer. The top of the screen includes navigation elements such as a back arrow, progress indicator (showing 1/2), and options to unlock or share the content.
